note: Seeds for cached YouTube data that CI refreshes lost (read by Catalogue.applySeeds in server/src/scheduler.js at the start of every refresh). playlists: playlists the channel lists from a MENA vantage point (read-only listChannelPlaylists runs on 2026-10-19) that are missing from the production cache (snapshot generation 37, 2026-10-18). CI (US runners) lists, and inside a playlist shows, fewer videos for these channels, and the old scheduler deleted cached playlists that one listing omitted. A seeded playlist absent from the cache is added as a placeholder (signature null, so it is fetched); its rows are rebuilt from cached details by video id (an entry written as an object carries its own row), a fetch that comes back empty or far shorter keeps them, and a stored fetch keeps the seeded rows it did not return unless it returned the whole playlist (at least the playlist's own video count) or details mark the video unavailable or private. uploads: documentary-length uploads-only videos that the fixed-size uploads window evicted after the 2026-10-16 snapshot; each is appended to its channel's UPLOADS list when absent, unless the uploads merge would trim it again (details mark it unavailable, private or not embeddable, or it is shorter than minEpisodeSeconds). Seeds of sources that are not configured are ignored. Regenerate only from a vantage point that sees these channels, and remove entries once the cache holds them again.
